description_en: Set the cloud computer maintenance mode
kebab_example: aliyun ecd set-desktop-maintenance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode enter --desktop-ids ecd-dzeotbgawdnfo0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDesktopMaintenance

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。

parameters.description_en:
Enter or exit cloud computer maintenance mode.

Enumerated values:

*   ENTER: The enters the maintenance mode.
*   EXIT: The exits the maintenance mode.
parameters.description_zh: 进入或退出云电脑维护模式。

parameters.description_en: A list of cloud computer IDs for which you want to set maintenance mode. A maximum of 100 cloud computer IDs are supported.
